entries.title: Zephaniah 3:1
segments:
CHAP. III. 
 
  Jerusalem threatened for her wickedness, ver. 1-7.   A promise of a glorious reformation, ver. 8-13.   And deliverance consequent upon it, ver. 14-20. 
 
  V. 1. To her-Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:2
segments: V. 2. The voice-Of God by his mercy and judgments crying aloud.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:3
segments: V. 3. Her princes-Persons of principal place and authority. Lions-Which hunt for prey, and are ever affrighting or devouring. Wolves-Insatiable and cruel, like wolves of the evening, whetted with hunger.  Gnaw not the bones-They leave nothing but the bones to be eaten on the morrow.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:4
segments: V. 4. Her prophet-So called, false prophets. Light-Unstable and inconstant. Violence to the law-Wresting it by perverse interpretation.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:5
segments: V. 5. In the midst-Observing all.  Not do iniquity-He will judge them righteously.  Every morning-Daily he discovers his displeasure against the wicked.  Faileth not-Lets no season slip to convince them, by public and visible punishments.  The unjust-But the wicked Jews proceed without shame, and without fear.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:6
segments: V. 6. The nations-Of old, the Canaanites, lastly the ten tribes, and later yet, the Assyrians.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:7
segments: V. 7. I said-I thought (speaking after the manner of men). Thou-O Jerusalem.  Fear me-For the many and great judgments executed upon others.  I punished them-In some measure.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:8
segments: V. 8. Therefore-Since you will not be amended. Wait ye-Attend my resolution.  Until-Until I rise up to destroy first, and next to take the spoil.  Upon them-The incorrigible Jews. Devoured-Consumed as if burnt up.  My jealousy-That jealousy wherewith God is jealous for his own glory.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:9
segments: V. 9. A pure language-I will give them a pure way of worshipping me, the issue of a pure heart.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:10
segments: V. 10. My dispersed-The praying remnant of the scattered Jews shall return to their own land, and bring themselves an offering unto the Lord.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:11
segments: V. 11. Thy doings-Thy sins formerly committed.  In thy pride-Proud formalists.  No more be haughty-Ye shall no more boast, because of the city, or the temple.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:12
segments: V. 12. Of thee-In Judea and Jerusalem.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:13
segments: V. 13. Shall feed-Shall enjoy peace and plenty.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:15
segments: V. 15. Taken away-Abolished, and put an end to the judgments thy sins brought upon thee.  Thine enemy-The Babylonian. Is in the midst-He is returned to redeem and govern thee. Any more-While thy carriage is as becomes my presence with thee, thou shalt neither fear, nor feel the like evils.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:18
segments: V. 18. Sorrowful-That mourn their distance from the solemn worship of God.  Who are of thee-Thy children.  Reproach-The taunts of their enemies.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:19
segments: V. 19. Undo-I will break their power and dissolve their kingdom. That halteth-Who is in trouble and ready to fall. Driven out-Into remote countries.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:20
segments: V. 20. A praise-So the universal church of the first-born will be, in the great day.  And then the Israel of God be made a name and a praise to all eternity.
